title: Cad Bane
description: Cad Bane was one of the top guns for hire during the Clone Wars. One of his most frequent clients was Darth Sidious, who trusted him enough to even break into the Jedi temple itself and steal a holocron. Eventually, Bane took Boba Fett under his wing and they worked together before Fett went to prison. When they went their separate ways, Fett went on to earn his own reputation. They met up again to settle their differences during a fight on Tatooine. under the baking suns, ready to see who would become the more legendary gunslinger...
